Original Decipher card face for [[Rebel Trooper Recruit]] (Official Tournament Sealed Deck), as shown in the card list on Decipher's own website.

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/sealeddeck/images/rebeltrooperrecruit.gif rebeltrooperrecruit.gif], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020616174248/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/sealeddeck/images/rebeltrooperrecruit.gif Internet Archive], 16 June 2002. SHA-256 of the archived file: 42983504505baaa844c66213eeebfa2fcbe694477995877cf6ed852f612d2a9e.

Edits: none. The file is the archived GIF byte for byte.

This replaces [[:File:OTSD-L-rebeltrooperrecruit-pc-crop.gif]] (formerly misnamed OTSD-L-rebeltrooperrecruit-decipher-archive.gif), which is a Players Committee copy, not Decipher's scan. The PC Holotable face is [[:File:OTSD-L-rebeltrooperrecruit.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
